Home ministry didn’t give Razakars’ list: Kamal
2019-12-18T16:38:39+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/news/home-ministry-didnt-give-razakars-list-liberation-war-ministry-kamal-1842004

Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal today said his ministry did not give any list of Razakars, Al-Badrs and Al-Shams to the Liberation War Affairs Ministry.

Rather the home ministry provided a list of those who are accused under the Collaborators Act, the minister said while briefing media at his office at the secretariat in Dhaka this afternoon.

“We gave notes asking to remove some 996 persons from the list, but the Liberation War ministry didn’t drop their names while publishing the list [of Razakars]. Therefore, it is the Liberation War ministry’s responsibility for this mistake in the list,” he said.

The minister also said action should be taken against the responsible persons.

Earlier on Monday, Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque told reporters that his ministry did not prepare the list of Razakars. They just published the list as it is provided by the home ministry, he added.
